newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi cannot confirm reported "tobashi" deal.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi cannot confirm reported "tobashi" deal.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Friday it could not confirm whether it had conducted questionable "tobashi" deals reported in a Japanese daily.
The Sankei Shimbun reported on Friday that Yamaichi, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokers, engaged in secret stock transactions with Tokyu Department Store Co Ltd involving at least 3.9 billion yen.

In "tobashi" or "pitching" transactions, brokerages shift investment losses suffered by one client to another firm, typically one with a different financial year, to prevent a favoured client from having to report the loss. Such deals could be determined to be in violation of Japan's securities law.
A Yamaichi spokesman said the company could not confirm whether it had conducted the reported deal.
"We cannot confirm whether it's true or not, so we cannot comment on the report," a spokesman said.
Tokyu Department Store was not immediately available for comment.
